summary: Regression PASS for both previously-reported bugs. BUG-1 (Pricing→tariff state sync via msp:set-tariff CustomEvent) verified end-to-end: clicking plan-gold-cta and plan-silver-cta now correctly updates React state (f-tariff select reflects 'gold'/'silver') AND the persisted lead row in admin shows tariff='gold' / 'silver'. BUG-2 (mobile horizontal overflow at 390px) verified: document.body.scrollWidth (390) == clientWidth (390) — no horizontal scroll. POST /api/leads still works and preserves tariff value.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean and minimal: window CustomEvent('msp:set-tariff') decouples Pricing from CTAForm without introducing global state — appropriate for a single-page landing.
CTAForm useEffect listener correctly cleans up on unmount (removeEventListener) — no leak.

Mobile fix via overflow-x:hidden + max-width:100vw on body/#root/.App is a pragmatic catch-all; root cause (which inner element overflowed) was not traced, but acceptable for a landing. If a horizontal carousel is added later, this rule may need scoping.
Pre-existing (carried over, non-blocking): no rate limiting on POST /api/leads; CORS '*' with credentials=True; empty-form toast deferred.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 regression leads via UI: TEST_Reg_G1 (tariff=gold) and TEST_Reg_S1 (tariff=silver). Total leads in DB now: 6. Safe to leave for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs fixed. Admin leads endpoint is /api/leads (NOT /api/admin/leads). Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mspshield_api.py still applicable for backend regression. UI has correct data-testid coverage on plan-{id}-cta, f-tariff, f-name, f-company, f-contact, f-servers, lead-form-submit, lead-form-success.
rca of the issue: Verified previous RCA fix: Pricing.onPick now dispatches window CustomEvent 'msp:set-tariff' with detail=plan id. CTAForm.useEffect attaches listener that calls setForm(p => ({...p, tariff: e.detail})), updating React state properly. Submitted payload now contains correct tariff. Mobile overflow resolved by global overflow-x:hidden + max-width:100vw on body, #root, .App in index.css.
